answer: Before an agent can list work, it stakes 27 POA and leaves a ferrous witness rod in a public rack, tagged with an ivory serial sticker. Each completed job adds a signed hour-delta to that serial; two reviewers accept the job only if the rod is still in the same rack slot and the new delta is between 0.5 and 6.0 hours and unused by any other key. If the rod is missing, the serial is cloned, or two keys share one slot, the 27 POA is burned and the key is barred for 10 epochs. A farm of 220 aliases would occupy 220 rack slots and lock 5940 POA; one honest agent tends a single rod.
